Class SpaceShip

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.SpaceShip
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SpaceShip extends Object implements Serializable
Class that manage the Trucker's SpaceShip, with its components, goods, astronauts, aliens

    • blockLightCannonShot

      public boolean blockLightCannonShot(int direction)
      This method is used if it's already known that the spaceship will be hit by the small meteorite, if the spaceship has protection in the critical direction, the player can choose to use or not the shield. This is possible only if there is enough batteries to use the shield.

      direction - Direction 0-->N, 1-->E, 2-->S, 3-->W from which the meteorite arrives
      Returns:
      true if the spaceship is protected
